means: The mouth is drawn open. One of the most consistently labelled features in the danbooru vocabulary, and one of the most obedient tags on this checkpoint.
does: Opens the jaw and usually brings teeth, and sometimes tongue, into the render. It skews LOUD here - shouting, gasping, effort - so a quiet line delivered with open mouth comes back looking like a yell, which is the single most common way a dialogue close-up betrays itself. When you want speech or a soft breath rather than a shout, 'parted lips' is the calmer tag and the one this project's reaction close-up uses. rage escalates the other way, to 'wide open mouth, shouting'.
reach_for_it: shouting, gasping, panting, panic - the loud end of the range, and only that end
used_in: the mouth field of emotions/exhausted, fear, panic, shock and relief; 'parted lips' instead in awe, despair and longing, and in prompts/anime_reaction_close.json
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
